_comment: Israel's average-speed sections, entered by hand from published police and
Netivei Israel announcements. OpenStreetMap will not carry these until well
after enforcement begins, so this file is the only source until it does.
This ships EMPTY on purpose. Every entry here becomes a live instruction to
a driver about how fast to travel, so nothing goes in it that has not been
read off an official announcement or driven and verified. Inventing
plausible coordinates would produce an app that coaches confidently against
a section that is not there.
See israel_zones.example.json for a filled-in entry, and
docs/ISRAEL_ZONES.md for the field reference and how to trace a path.
Add sections here, then run:  make seed-israel
